core_obligations: Reduction (proof lines 684-691): choosing an injective resolution of F on X_Zar and using the definitions, it suffices to show (1) the restriction of an injective abelian sheaf on X_Zar to (X x_Y V)_Zar is an injective abelian sheaf, and (2) a_*F is the rule V |-> H^0((X x_Y V)_Zar, F restricted to (X x_Y V)_Zar).

Part (2) (lines 692-705): (2a) a_*F is the equalizer of a_{0,*}F_0 -> a_{1,*}F_1 by the augmentation lemma; (2b) the component pushforwards evaluate as a_{0,*}F_0(V) = H^0(a_0^{-1}(V), F_0) and a_{1,*}F_1(V) = H^0(a_1^{-1}(V), F_1); (2c) X_0 x_Y V = a_0^{-1}(V) and X_1 x_Y V = a_1^{-1}(V); (2d) H^0 of the total-site section is the equalizer of H^0(X_0 x_Y V, F_0) -> H^0(X_1 x_Y V, F_1) by the simplicial sheaf cohomology lemma; stringing these together proves (2).
Part (1) (lines 706-710): the restriction Ab(X_Zar) -> Ab((X x_Y V)_Zar) has the exact left adjoint j_! (extension by zero), which preserves injectives by the Homology lemma.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the two claims via an injective resolution of F.
Prove the degree-zero description by chaining the equalizer description of a_* with the component evaluations and the H^0 description on the total site.
Prove injectivity of the restriction via the exact left adjoint j_!.
difficulty_reason: Description lemma (statement 668-677, proof 679-711): computes R^n a_*F as the sheaf associated to V |-> H^n((X x_Y V)_Zar, F restricted there) by reducing to two verifications - the degree-zero equalizer computation assembled from the augmentation lemma and the simplicial H^0 description, and injectivity of the restriction via the exact left adjoint j_!; both are given in full; no verification is omitted. H2: standard higher-direct-image computation transplanted to the simplicial augmentation.
